role: prospective within-species replication of the altitude-wide dry-season architecture discovered in the frozen 2022 endpoint

season_context.external_basis: source study methods identify February-March 2016 and 2022 as dry-season sampling

exclusions.deployment_manipulation: exclude if manipulation_type is present and not 'none'
exclusions.source_outliers: no explicit outlier field exists; require visible=true when visible is present

session.self_training: other eligible sessions from the same individual within the same cohort only

cohort.shifted_night_rule: timestamp minus 12 hours, then calendar date

horizontal.projection_rule: per admitted cohort UTM chosen from median x-y before height values are parsed

vertical.primary_semantics: native GPS height above mean sea level, matching the 2022 dry-season dataset

prediction.origin: new prediction generated from the already frozen 2022 dry-season result before 2016 numeric height values were opened
primary_required: more than half of evaluable individuals have positive marginal identity gain
more than half of evaluable individuals have negative identity_x_location increment
marginal identity gain exceeds conditional identity gain

claim_boundary: a pass would replicate the 2022 dry-season specialization architecture in an earlier dry-season panel
it would not prove season causation because year, instrumentation and other context differ
a failure is retained and the rule is not retuned
flight-use organization only; no direct foraging-state classification is imposed
